name: kerno
description: Runtime QA harness for backend coding agents. Kerno automatically generates, runs, and maintains integration tests locally against your real stack, so your agent catches and fixes its own regressions every session, before they reach a PR.

interface.shortDescription: Kerno MCP skills, bootstrap workflows, and MCP setup
interface.longDescription: Slash-style skills and references for the Kerno agent MCP server: first-time install, environment bootstrap, async jobs, and validation.
